entries.title: Trading hours, half-day trading and Singapore public holidays (sgx.com/stock-exchange/trading, content API)
entries.notes: "SGX follows the Singapore holiday calendar available on the Ministry of Manpower website. The Eve of Chinese New Year, Eve of Christmas and Eve of New Year in 2025 & 2026 fall on business days. As such, there will be half-day trading in 2025 & 2026": 28 January, 24 and 31 December 2025; 16 February, 24 and 31 December 2026. Session tables with the 12:16 half-day close (trade-at-close).

entries.title: SGX markets' outage resulted from malfunction in power supply (news release, 5 November 2014)
entries.notes: "Market participants were disconnected at 1418 hours and SGX declared a formal trading halt at 1451 hours ... the market reopened for trading at 1715 hours ... the market closed at 1751 hours." An extended, not shortened, trading day: no calendar event.

entries.title: Delayed market open for the securities market on 3 December 2014 (news release)
entries.notes: "the securities market will start continuous trading at 1230 hrs on 3rd December 2014 ... The market will remain open till 1700 hrs and close as per normal." A delayed open with a normal close: no calendar event.

entries.title: SGX provides further details on market disruption (news release, 19 July 2016)
entries.notes: "Singapore Exchange's (SGX) securities market experienced a market disruption on Thursday, 14 July 2016, when the exchange ceased trading at 1138 hours, and remained closed for the rest of the day."

entries.title: SGX securities market trades all day from 1 August 2011 (news release, republished by Mondo Visione)
entries.notes: Removal of the 12:30-14:00 lunch break: session structure only.

entries.title: SGX's securities and derivatives markets will remain open (statement, 3 April 2020, republished by Mondo Visione)
entries.notes: The exchange stayed open through Singapore's COVID-19 circuit breaker.

entries.title: ISDA guidance on Singapore election market closures (Equity Definitions)
entries.notes: Corroboration: "the SGX will not be open for trading on Friday 10th July 2020 ... in respect of the securities market".

entries.title: SGX securities market "Number of Trading Days" by month, December 2010 - June 2026 (table compiled from the SGX Monthly Market Statistics Reports and the exchange's monthly statistics releases)
entries.covers: 2010-12-01 to 2026-06-30 (171 months; see notes for the gaps)
entries.notes: One row per month read directly from the exchange's report PDF or its "SGX reports market statistics" release, with the document URL and the SHA-256 of the document as retrieved. Every month equals the modelled weekdays less closures (half days and the 14 July 2016 disruption count as trading days). Not found: January-November 2010 (the row was added to the reports from October 2010), July 2012, April-October and December 2013, May-June 2014, June 2015, July 2020 and April-June 2023; those months stay PROJECTED.
